_comment: Passed via --health-config; persisted and applied on boot. A threshold set to 0 (or omitted) INHERITS the built-in default (it does not disable the signal). CPU and load alerting are ON by default (cpu 85/95, load 1.0/2.0 per core); the seeded rule's 2-observation flap window means a single-sample spike will not page. To relax a signal on hot hosts, raise its thresholds here. See docs/manual/configuration.md.

batch._comment: Batch/CI boxes run hot on purpose — raise CPU/load so normal load does not page.

db-01._comment: This host must keep postgres running; a stopped/absent watched service is critical.
